purpose: Characterization and prototype selection, not confirmation or Elo
baseline: ProductionSearch.create Policy 4, pinned Pair-2 generation 32, 64 MiB TT
baselineSampling: First 8 roots, one full warmup traversal, two measured rounds, depth ceiling 20 and 100000 admitted nodes per complete driver request; separate 1 and 4 worker runs
profile: Separate JFR profile baseline run; never include instrumented timings in clean cost comparison. Record JVM compilation and native memory output.
metrics: Whole driver wall/process CPU (all workers, JIT and GC), owner CPU, live-thread allocated bytes, heap/GC, compilation, completed depth/PV, full main/q work including aborted attempts; new-game clearing reported separately. Construction excluded.
resources: One BelowNormal JVM, OpenJDK 21, Xms256m Xmx768m ActiveProcessorCount=2; no concurrent tests/benchmarks
prototype: Primitive explicit qsearch frames only, main PVS and root coordination retained. Recursive implementation unchanged. Eligibility restricted to equivalent unpruned or QXRAY leaves; no production selection.
gates: Resolve all correctness mismatches before timing interpretation. Use deterministic one-worker parity and independent unpruned references. Multiworker traversal can vary; separately validate lifecycle, private ownership, budgets and legal publication.
stopping: Select next experiment from measured cost and code complexity. No closed-run extension, favorable sample selection, or full-flattening conclusion from partial equivalence. Freeze fresh comparison and uncertainty criteria before substantial confirmation. Safety deadline failure is censored evidence, not inferiority.
